title: Borrowers can be left with debt shares after full repayment
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Borrowers can be left with debt shares after full repayment of their debt. This is due to the calculation of the `shareChange` value rounding down.  ```solidity File: LiquidityPool.sol  155:     function repay(uint marginAccountID, uint amount) external onlyRole(MARGIN_ACCOUNT_ROLE) { (...) 164:  @>     uint shareChange = (amount * debtSharesSum) / newTotalBorrows; // Trader's share to be given away 165:         uint profit = (accruedInterest * shareChange) / shareOfDebt[marginAccountID]; 166:         uint profitInsurancePool
